# facet GRUB theme in the bloom style ({{name}} colors)

# corner pictures and three bands of a 1x1 picture in the surface color.

# ── The entries ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# The picked entry's pill is a 9-slice (select_*.png) that GRUB draws around the item: 18 px
# corners above, below and beside a 9 px item, so it is 44 px high with the mockup's radius
# 18 (the text is centered on the item and may overhang it). item_spacing makes the rows
# 48 px apart; five fit before the list scrolls.

+ boot_menu {
  left = 50%-238
  top = 50%-140
  width = 476
  height = 276
  item_font = "Bloom Sans Regular 15"
  selected_item_font = "Bloom Sans Regular 15"
  item_color = "{{tones.dim}}"
  selected_item_color = "{{tones.onPrimary}}"
  item_height = 9
  item_padding = 18
  item_spacing = 39
  icon_width = 0
  icon_height = 0
  item_icon_space = 0
  selected_item_pixmap_style = "select_*.png"
  scrollbar = false
}

# ── Bottom: countdown ring, what happens, keys ───────────────
# The ring is GRUB's circular_progress: 64 dots in the accent on a track, one going out
# after another as the time runs down. Everything with id __timeout__ goes away once a key
# is pressed.

+ circular_progress {
  id = "__timeout__"
  left = 50%-238
  top = 50%+147
  width = 36
  height = 36
  num_ticks = 64
  ticks_disappear = true
  start_angle = -64
  center_bitmap = "ring_track.png"
  tick_bitmap = "ring_tick.png"
}

+ label {
